status: Uncommitted narrow security pin; local structural validation passed; new build and instrumentation verification pending coordinated CI

wrapperJar.rationale: The Gradle manual permits a manual distributionUrl upgrade and says newer Gradle distributions can normally run using older wrapper files. The inspected security advisories concern Gradle distribution components; no requirement to replace this verified launcher JAR was found.

securityApplicability.assessment: The pinned version 8.13 is affected by the advisory range. Exploitation requires a malicious version catalog; no local or imported catalog was found in the inspected Android configuration. This is not evidence of exploitation.

The pinned version 8.13 is affected. The pre-authentication daemon channel issue requires access on the build host; it is not a remote APK issue. A disposable single-tenant runner limits exposure. CI uses a single-use daemon even with --no-daemon, so that flag is not treated as eliminating applicability.

The pinned version 8.13 is affected by the repository SSL-failure fallback issue. The build has multiple repositories, but exploitation also requires attack prerequisites including control of a subsequently selected repository. No compromise is asserted.
